page_data.en:
Misc. 810/40.
Bubbling Well MUNICIPAL POLICE
Dec. 3. a. REGISTRY
D. 99290.
Strike at the "Consolidated Industries" Fed. Inc., U.S.A. 2111
Great Western Road, S.C.O.P.B.
D.S.I. Golobkoff C.I.
Officer i/c District.

Sir,

At 9.20 a.m. 14-12-40, Mr. I. Gutman, Chief
Engineer of the Consolidated Industries, Fed. Inc., U.S.
A., 111 Great Western Road came to the station and
reported that the workers at the above company went on
strike.

According to Mr. J. Gutman the premises at the above
address are occupied by the workshops of several American
machine tools manufacturing companies, operated under
the general name of the "Consolidated Industries".

On 10-12-40, the workers, about 400 in number
presented demands for increase of wages. On 13-12-40
the management agreed to grant an increase of $6.00 a
month to each worker. This did not satisfy the workers
and at 5 a.m. 14-12-40 the night shift, about 100 workers
in number refused to leave the premises and would not
allow anyone to enter the same. Mr. I. Gutman requested
the Police assistance to clear the premises, as the
workers might damage the machinery.

The above premises are situated in Chinese Territory
with the entrance from a lane leading to Tsang Ka Zah
Village.

In view of the above Mr. I. Gutman, on instructions
of D. O. "B" was referred to the S.C.O.P.B.

〔此处有手写签名及印章：EXECUTED (A) REGISTRY DATE 17/12/40〕
D. S. I.

D.D.O. "B" Div.
Copy to Special Branch.

静安寺路 工部局警务处
12月3日。a. 登记处
D. 99290。
美国联合工业股份有限公司（Consolidated Industries, Fed. Inc., U.S.A.）罢工案 2111
大西路111号，S.C.O.P.B.
警司 Golobkoff 首席探员。
辖区负责警官。

先生：

1940年12月14日上午9时20分，美国联合工业股份有限公司首席工程师 I. Gutman 先生来到本分局报案，称上述公司工人举行罢工。

据 J. Gutman 先生称，上述地址的厂房由几家美国机床制造公司的车间占用，统称为“联合工业”（Consolidated Industries）。

1940年12月10日，约400名工人提出增加工资的要求。1940年12月13日，资方同意给每名工人每月加薪6.00元。但这并未使工人满意，1940年12月14日凌晨5时，夜班工人（约100人）拒绝离开工厂，并禁止任何人进入。I. Gutman 先生请求警方协助清理工厂，因为工人可能会损坏机器。

上述厂址位于华界，入口通向张家宅村的一条弄堂。

鉴于上述情况，根据“B”区副督察长的指示，I. Gutman 先生被转介至 S.C.O.P.B.（上海公共租界工部局警务处特别分部）。

〔此处有手写签名及印章：已执行 (A) 登记处 日期 1940年12月17日〕

STRIKE AT THE CONSOLIDATED INDUSTRIES LTD.,
111. GREAT WESTERN ROAD.

At 7.30p.m. on the 4/9/40 a telephone message was
received from the Consolidated Industries Ltd., 111,
Great Western Road to the effect that a strike was in
progress and trouble anticipated. S.J. Wilcox, D.S.I.
Hide and party attended and found the situation quiet on
arrival.

Enquiries elicited that three mechanics named S
Nyi Tsai (史銀才), Tsang Hong Sing (張鴻興) and Bing
Hong Cheng (平洪祥) failed to return to work at 1.00
p.m. after the tiffin hour on the 3/9/40.

At 7.30a.m. on the 4/9/40 S Nyi Tsai reported for
work in the usual manner but Mr. I. Gutman, the Chief
Engineer, refused to admit him and informed him that
three absentees were dismissed. This resulted in
some 180 male employees of the Machine Tools Dept.
ceasing work and demanding the reinstatement of the
three workers.

The dispute continued until the manager Mr. S.
Jedelkin arrived at 8.15a.m. and promised to reinstate
the three employees. This failed to satisfy the
employees who then put forward demands for an increase
in pay and rice allowance. The manager replied to
the effect that no further increases could be granted

1.

联合工业有限公司罢工案，
大西路111号。

1940年9月4日下午7时30分，接到大西路111号联合工业有限公司的电话消息，称正在发生罢工，预计会有骚乱。警司 Hide 和随行人员前往，到达时发现局势平静。

经查询得知，三名技工，名为史銀才 (S Nyi Tsai)、張鴻興 (Tsang Hong Sing) 和平洪祥 (Bing Hong Cheng)，在1940年9月3日午餐时间后于下午1时未返回工作岗位。

1940年9月4日上午7时30分，史銀才按惯例报到上班，但首席工程师 I. Gutman 先生拒绝让他进入，并告知他这三名缺勤者已被解雇。这导致机床部约180名男员工停止工作，要求复职这三名工人。

纠纷一直持续到经理 S. Jedelkin 先生于上午8时15分到达，并承诺恢复这三名员工的职务。但这未能满足员工的要求，他们随后提出了增加工资和米贴的要求。经理答复称，无法再给予进一步加薪

and that any person who wished to resign could do so.
At 1.30p.m., in response to a telephone call, Mr.
Koo of the Industrial Section attended the factory and
was successful in inducing the strikers to resume work
at about 5.00p.m. on the understanding that enquiries
were to be made as to the rates of pay in similar firms
and any difference adjusted. However, the day shift
workers left at about 6.30p.m. instead of 7.00p.m. and
it is stated by the management that they prevented the
majority of the 80 night shift workers from entering
the premises. About twenty such workers were on the
premises when the Police party arrived.
The Chinese No.1 Wong Kyung Foh ( 黃金福) and
four foremen Yang S Sung ( 楊世興), Sung Yeong Ling
( 沈永林), Sung Wei Chong ( 孫偉昌) and Hoo Ching
Foh ( 胡慶甫) stated that the strike was not
premeditated and that there were no definite leaders
or agitators. However, they stated that it appeared
one
that S Nyi Tsai and Hsu Ching Huh ( 徐清和) were
instrumental in bringing matters to a head.
So far as could be ascertained the remaining 350
day shift workers of other departments are not affect-
ed by the strike.
Special Branch informed.
John Cophlan
Sgn.Det.I/C.
Lundon
D. S. I.

并表示任何希望辞职的人都可以辞职。下午1时30分，应电话邀请，工业科的顾先生 (Mr. Koo) 来到工厂，并成功促使罢工者在下午5时左右复工，条件是调查同类公司的工资率，并调整任何差异。然而，白班工人在下午6时30分左右离开，而不是通常的下午7时，据资方称，他们阻止了80名夜班工人中的大多数人进入工厂。当警察小队到达时，约有二十名此类工人在厂内。

华人一号黄金福 (Wong Kyung Foh) 和四名领班杨世兴 (Yang S Sung)、沈永林 (Sung Yeong Ling)、孙伟昌 (Sung Wei Chong) 和胡庆甫 (Hoo Ching Foh) 表示，罢工并非预谋，也没有明确的领导人或煽动者。然而，他们表示，似乎史銀才 (S Nyi Tsai) 和徐清和 (Hsu Ching Huh) 在促使事态激化方面起了作用。

据查，其他部门的其余350名白班工人未受罢工影响。
已通知特别分部。
John Cophlan

Lundon

LABOUR UNREST AT THE CONSOLIDATED INDUSTRIES CO.,
FED: INC.,U.S.A. 111-113 GREAT WESTERN ROAD,O.O.L.

At 7.00 p.m. 4-4-40, a telephone message was
received from the management of the above concern
reporting labour unrest.

D.S.Till and C.D.S.163 and C.D.C.328 immediately
attended, ascertaining upon arrival that Sergeant
Eatwell, East Surrey Regiment 1/c of a Party, were
already in attendance, it being learned that they were
called to the factory by the manager Mr. S.Jedeikin,
Latvian, from west Post, at the intersection of Great
Western and Edinburgh Roads, a few minutes before the
arrival of detectives.

Sergeant Eatwell stated, that when Mr. Jedeikin
came to the Post he stated that the workers were in a
troublesome mood and that possible damage to the plant
was imminent. This assumption, however, proved to be
incorrect.

It was learned from the manager, that the factory
employs a complement of 300 male Chinese workers, 250
on day shift, and 50 on night shift. The unrest was
confined to the Machine Tool Dept, affecting approximate-
ly 150 workers.

Enquiries revealed, that prior to the Easter
Holidays, the workers in this Dept. approached the
management and requested a days holiday on Good Friday

1.

美国联合工业公司（Consolidated Industries Co., Fed: Inc., U.S.A.）劳资纠纷，
大西路111-113号，O.O.L.

1940年4月4日下午7时，接到上述公司管理层电话，报告发生劳资纠纷。

警司 Till 和刑事侦探第163号及刑事侦探第328号立即前往，到达后获悉东萨里团负责一个小队的 Eatwell 中士已在场，得知他们在侦探到达前几分钟，被经理、拉脱维亚人 S. Jedeikin 先生从大西路和爱丁堡路交叉口的西哨所叫到工厂。

Eatwell 中士称，当 Jedeikin 先生来到哨所时，他说工人们情绪不稳，工厂设备可能 imminent 遭受损坏。然而，这一假设被证明是不正确的。

据经理称，该工厂雇佣了300名中国男工，其中250人上白班，50人上夜班。纠纷局限于机床部，影响约150名工人。

经查询得知，在复活节假期之前，该部门的工人曾接触管理层，要求在耶稣受难日放假一天
